text:
kevin: Flagging CardioLabs invoice INV-9001 — they were charged a recurring "ps_config" line after Private went live. Customer insists PS was a one-time setup, not recurring. Invoice: https://invoices.internal/INV-9001 cc @sylvia

rachael: I checked billing events. Private deployment activated 2026-08-12, and our billing job applied a "ps_config" SKU with recurring frequency due to a template bug. Should have been one-time.

sylvia: Oof. Customer emailed account exec saying "one-time setup only" on 2026-07-30. We need to correct and credit any future-recurring amounts billed this cycle and reverse the next invoice if it already scheduled.

ash: Invoice extract:
```
platform_fee        12,000.00   08/01 - 08/31
ps_config(recurring) 2,400.00   monthly
```
We need to remove recurring PS from next cycle and credit the customer for the recurring charge that hit this invoice. Proposed credit = full monthly PS 2400. Also consider goodwill for customer inconvenience?

marco: Approve technical correction credit for recurring mischarge. GL: 4-102-OnboardCredits for the PS reversal. For goodwill, cap at $500 and charge to sales concessions if approved by Rachael.

rachael: Approve $2,400 credit for the recurring PS mischarge. Also approve goodwill $300 (we keep $300 this time). Sales will absorb goodwill. Please attach AE email confirming one-time PS.

legal: Please include "billing system error - no recurring entitlement" language in memo and attach customer confirmation. Also require a short note that this is non-precedent.

billing-bot: Adjustment record created: ADJ-13055 amount: -2400.00 status: pending approval. Goodwill line: ADJ-13056 amount: -300.00 status: pending approval.

kevin: Will issue ADJ-13055 and ADJ-13056 as credit memos and apply to INV-9001. GLs: 4-102-OnboardCredits (-2400), 4-130-SalesConcessions (-300).

billing-bot: ADJ-13055 posted. ADJ-13056 posted. Links: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-13055 , https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-13056

sylvia: I removed the recurring flag in the product template to prevent future misbilling and opened ticket PROD-788 to rollout a fix.

marco: Please make sure revenue ops gets the reversal journal entries. Also coordinate with finance to ensure ARR isn't overstated for the month.

rachael: AE email attached to both ADJs. Notifying customer that we've applied $2,700 total credit to INV-9001 (no cash refund). Customer acknowledged and appreciated quick fix. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
